text:
elena: Heads-up — telemetry is showing a spike in 'generate' error rate for customers on the new 2.1 rollout. Asking: do we treat this as a bug-first post-launch slice or balance with the enhancement backlog?
elena: attaching quick numbers from Datadog — not a prod incident, but signal strong enough to impact usage.
sam: saw this earlier. Rolling 2.1 -> 2.0 fallback triggered for 3 customers. Aggregate error rate up ~0.7% last 6h vs 0.05% baseline.
sam: top error is 'RPC timeout while fetching KV cache' — mostly long-sequence requests.
jordan: thanks. Can you paste the top 3 customer IDs and sample traces? want to check prompt lengths and routing policy.
sam: quick paste: cust-a12, cust-x03, cust-b7. Sample trace snippet:
```
2026-03-22T18:12:03Z ERR fetch_kv: timeout 2000ms model=gpt-redwood-2.1 seq=8192 route=best-effort
2026-03-22T18:12:04Z WARN fallback to quantized-variant model=gpt-redwood-2.0 seq=8192
```
mike: sounds like a latency/regime issue for long contexts. Could be batching/kv eviction threshold.
mike: proposal: short-term mitigation -> increase KV timeout for 2.1 by 1s and add canary with aggressive prefix cache for affected customers.
elena: what's impact to cost/latency if we bump timeout globally?
jordan: rough calc — bumping timeout adds ~1-2% token lifecycle cost but keeps customer requests successful (reduces retries). Worth for top-tier customers.
opsbot: [alert] 1742009560 - Model variant 2.1 health degraded — autoscaling attempted +2 pods, saturation at 85%.
elena: OK. So plan I'm hearing: 1) triage owners (sam + mike) to validate root cause, 2) temporary config change for affected customers (timeout + caching), 3) schedule a 30m telemetry-driven grooming session to decide bug-vs-enhancement priority for remaining signals, 4) set an SLO trigger to auto-promote fixes if error_rate > 0.5% for 2h.
mike: I can push the config change as hotfix to dedicated and hosted canaries.
sam: will collect traces and correlate with sequence length + routing policy. I'll have a report by EOD.
jordan: for the grooming session — suggest we bring PM, infra, and 1 customer success rep. Use the template: impact, repro steps, owner, rollback plan, cost delta.
elena: adding PM (anna) & CS (nate) to the invite. meeting at 10:30 PT tomorrow.
mike: noted. I'll include a quick AB test with the timeout change so we can measure success.
elena: thanks — outcome: if canary reduces error_rate under 0.3% and latency impact <5%, we ship rollback and prioritize a reliable fix in the next sprint; otherwise we escalate to platform upgrade. :thumbsup:
jordan: +1
mike: +1
